copy.headline: North Texas officer placed on leave following Flock audit, police say
copy.caption: North Texas officer placed on leave following Flock audit, police say. Carrollton police say the audit follows citizen concerns that were brought up during city council meetings.

story.title: North Texas officer placed on leave following Flock audit, police say
story.summary: Carrollton police say the audit follows citizen concerns that were brought up during city council meetings.
